'''Pirate Queen''' was a title for [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leaders, similar to [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]]. It was held by individuals such as the [[pirate queen of Ando]],<ref name="APotWM">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref> and the Pirate Queen of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]].<ref name="MotPQ">''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''</ref>
